parsed.title: Daily Reader Streak
parsed.oneLiner: Earn virtual credits daily to unlock premium news summaries by playing interactive mini-games.

economy: AD TODAY native on Home News Feed (e42)

newMechanic.name: AOL News Credits
newMechanic.description: A habit-building virtual currency earned through daily streaks and rewarded ads, redeemable for ad-light reading sessions and advanced article summaries.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: AOL currently has no scarce resource; News Credits create a value exchange to monetize non-paying attention via opt-in ads.

parsed.trigger: A user opens the Account Menu Sidebar to manage settings and sees a new Daily Streak progress card.
parsed.eligibility: Non-signed-in users and signed-in non-subscribers who haven't claimed today's reward.

offer.title: Daily Reading Streak
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL to earn 10 News Credits and keep your streak alive!

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is a small daily amount that cannot be stacked to replace the core subscription value; it acts as a sampling mechanic for premium features.
risks: User perceived value of credits may start low until redemption utility is expanded.
Potential fatigue if the streak mechanic feels repetitive.

newElements.change: Add a 'Daily Reader Streak' section with a progress bar and a 'Claim Credits' button.

storyboard.caption: A user opens the sidebar to access their settings or saved articles.
A new 'Daily Reader Streak' card appears below the settings menu.
The user taps to earn credits, triggering a Simula rewarded game invitation.
The user plays a 15-second sponsored mini-game with the AOL game partner.
After the game, the streak is updated and 10 News Credits are granted.
